title: Lesson 47 - You Shouldn't Have Had to Ask

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Aisha, I read your reply to Priya. You shouldn't have had to ask her to separate the original poster from the extra graphics.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: I appreciate you saying that. I was surprised that the email sounded as if I had already agreed to a Friday deadline.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: That happened because I wrote that you could probably adapt the poster into three launch graphics. I should have checked with you first.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: What did Priya know about the original agreement?

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: She knew you had offered one poster after the text and permissions were ready. I shouldn't have assumed that the extra versions would be a small extension.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: They may look related, but each version still needs final wording, sizing and review. Your message put me in an awkward position.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: You're right. That was my mistake. I could have handled it differently by asking you privately before mentioning your name.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: I know your intention was to help the center plan, but the impact was an expectation that I had to correct.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Exactly. My intention doesn't remove that impact.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: What I should have done was tell Priya that only the poster was agreed and that any additional work needed a new conversation.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Yes. I didn't need you to reject the request for me; I needed my availability not to be announced before I answered.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: I'm sorry I spoke for you. Here's how I'll correct it: I'll email Priya today, state that the Friday graphics were never agreed, and take responsibility for creating that impression.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Please copy me so the record is clear.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: I will. I'll also ask future requesters to contact you directly rather than describing what you may be able to do.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: That would help. I still want to make the original poster once the approved material is ready.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Understood. I won't connect that commitment to any other deliverable.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Thank you. I don't need a long explanation; I need the correction and a different process next time.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: You'll have both. I'll send the correction before noon and forward you Priya's reply.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Then we can move on without pretending the extra request was part of the original plan.
